prompt:
Sun-bleached beach-club T-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

Big hand-painted brush lettering carries the main text, which reads exactly "{crew}".
Behind the lettering a flat sunset with palm silhouettes and a horizon stripe.
[[A curved lower line reads exactly "{jahr}".]]
[[A small handwritten brush line under the sunset reads exactly "{spruch}".]]

[[Include a subtle motif that clearly evokes the sport "{sportart}" - for example the matching ball or a piece of equipment for that sport - worked into the composition as a small graphic accent, not as text.]]

Do not draw any emblem, crest, shield or badge anywhere.

Style: flat three-color risograph print in coral, turquoise and warm sand, coarse grain, thick confident outlines, no photorealism, no gradients.
